note: Hancock County park and marina on the Ohio River at Newell in the Northern Panhandle, run by a county concessionaire (Century Energy Management Co., CEMCO, since April 2025; the county ended the previous concessionaire's agreement in January 2025). About 36 RV sites plus primitive sites; boat ramp, bait and tackle shop. Open mid-May to mid-September. Max RV length reported around 30 ft. --Claude
